issues.original: Inference in Structural Vector Autoregressions Identified with an External Instrument
issues.corrected: Inference in Structural Vector Autoregressions identified with an external instrument
issues.reason: Cosmetic only, not an error: the .bib gives the title in Title Case, while the publisher (ScienceDirect/Elsevier), Princeton's collaborate page, and RePEc/IDEAS all render it in sentence case ('identified'/'external' lowercase). BibTeX styles normally re-case titles automatically, so this does not need fixing, but noting it since exact-string checkers may flag it.
